name: arkaik
description: The Arkaik agent skills, distributed as Claude Code plugins: `arkaik` maintains a product's graph map (ProjectBundle), `kritik` audits its quality.

plugins.name: arkaik
plugins.description: Maintain the Arkaik product graph map — add, update, or remove nodes/edges and record matching journal events.

plugins.name: kritik
plugins.description: Audit a product's quality with the Kritik framework — score each criterion per surface against observable anchors, record findings with risk and cost, and roll it up into a comparative matrix.
